يستلمان (form VIII)
# يَسْتَلِمَانِ (yastalimāni) /jas.ta.li.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# يُسْتَلَمَانِ (yustalamāni) /jus.ta.la.maː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
